export function paginate<T>( items: T[], page: number, perPage =10): Page<T> {

  // validation for perPage

  if ( ! Number.isInteger( perPage ) || perPage <1 ) {

     throw new RangeError("perPage must be an integer of 1 or more.");

  }

   const totalItems = items.length;

   const totalPages = totalItems ===0 ?1 : Math.ceil( totalItems / perPage );

   let current = Math.floor( page );

   if ( isNaN(current) || current <1 ) {

        current =1;

    } else if ( current > totalPages ) {

        current = totalPages;

    }

    const start = (current-1)* perPage;

    const pageItems = items.slice(start, start+ perPage);

    return {

        items: pageItems,

        page: current,

        perPage: perPage,

        totalItems: totalItems,

        totalPages: totalPages,

        hasPrev: current>1,

        hasNext: (start + perPage) < totalItems

    };

}
